sloka: सिंहार्दितानामिव कुञ्जराणां निशाचराणां सह कुञ्जराणाम् ।रवाश्च वेगाश्च समं बभूवुः पुराणसिंहेन विमर्दितानाम् ।। ७.७.५२ ॥
transliteration: siṁhārditānāmiva kuñjarāṇāṁ niśācarāṇāṁ saha kuñjarāṇām ।ravāśca vegāśca samaṁ babhūvuḥ purāṇasiṁhena vimarditānām ।। 7.7.52 ॥

translations.english: The roars and frantic movements of the Rakshasas and their elephants, tormented by the ancient lion, were like those of elephants distressed by a lion.
